limitations: Model derived from the supplied Floorplanner export, not a measured survey or an as-built structural record.
All ground-floor wall segments have the same source height (3.8862 m); individual wall and column heights are unverified.
Column classifications are inferred from repeated wall geometry. They are physically unverified and do not establish structural capacity or condition.
Source column wall loops are retained as source-shaped perimeter solids, rather than replaced with idealized filled cubes.
Catalog door leaves, window frames, fittings, furnishings and texture assets are not included in the native geometry. Door voids are cut; window voids include a simple glazing proxy.
Floor area polygons are source planes at elevation zero; no invented floor thickness or finished-floor elevation is added.
The elevated source surface is categorized as canopy by elevation and its matching walkway footprint. No roof pitch, fascia detail or new exterior is invented.
Second Floor design 193835178 is omitted because registration to the ground floor is unverified. The native export preserves it.
Alternative ground-floor design 189209676 is omitted; this model uses design 241952337 only.
No georeferencing, surveyed coordinates, tenant area reconciliation, maintenance status or live sensor data are asserted.
